items.prompt: For positions [0,10] and velocities [1,3], why is there no future meeting?

options.why: The initial positions are distinct by 10.

options.text: Separation and closing difference have opposite signs.
options.why: The faster agent is already ahead, so their equality occurs only at a negative time.

options.text: Any positive velocity prevents a collision.
options.why: Relative motion, not a positive sign alone, controls future meeting.

options.text: The horizon must be negative to test this case.
options.why: The function correctly rejects a nonpositive meeting time for any valid nonnegative horizon.
